# CVGrid App — Comprehensive AI Documentation & Entity Knowledge Base

> Comprehensive reference for AI answer engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) and generative crawlers interacting with CVGrid's web applications and tooling.

## 1. Overview
CVGrid (https://app.cvgrid.in) is the application portal for CVGrid. It provides browser-based resume creation, ATS scoring, cover letter generation, and career preparation tools.

## 2. Tools & Capabilities
1. **Resume Builder**: Step-by-step editor with real-time PDF preview and intelligent content generation.
2. **ATS Checker**: Real-time scoring of candidate resumes against job descriptions with keyword gap detection.
3. **Cover Letter Generator**: Generates matching cover letters.
4. **Portfolio Generator**: Creates a hosted portfolio from resume details.
5. **Interview Question Prep**: Prepares candidates for job-specific interview questions.

## 3. Pricing
- 100% Free plan with watermark-free PDF downloads.
- ₹150 INR one-time premium unlock. Zero recurring subscriptions.
